name: Pollen
desc: Seed on the wind, built as real structure rather than specks — dandelion parachutes trailing their stalk and seed, thistledown puffs and bristled spore clusters, each a crown of bowed filaments that tumbles edge-on and opens again as it rides a thermal, blooming where it drifts across the light.

energy.doc: crown size, filament brightness and wander amplitude

density.doc: how much seed is in the air

mix.doc: morph: 0 = dandelion parachutes, 0.5 = thistledown puffs, 1 = bristled spore clusters

spin.doc: tumble rate — how fast crowns roll edge-on and open again

x.doc: thermal + backlight x — motes gather toward it as they climb and bloom near it

alpha.doc: master opacity over the scene below

seed.doc: seeding — depth, kind, filament count and splay
